_source: Static UI keys for the mobile PM close summary (route pm-close, pototype/mobile-pm.jsx MPMClose L181-217). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. MIXED LAYERS (the approvals_inbox / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent): fields marked dict below are stable ids read with t() (checkProgress with tf(), it carries {n}/{count}); the rest are the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key, read with tp(). Every prototype line number here was re-grepped against the raw .jsx this round and each value byte-verified (glyph by glyph: the row-2 separator and the composed 'ผลตรวจ' value use ASCII middot U+00B7, the 'เริ่ม-เสร็จ' label uses ASCII hyphen U+002D — the en-dash U+2013 in the prototype's VALUE '09:14 – 10:48 น.' is mock data, never keyed). ZERO-MINT WHERE POSSIBLE — 5 of the 12 original slots resolve today because the merged web PM screens render this same close panel: rowAsset=pm.fieldAsset 'อุปกรณ์' (L201) · rowTotalTime=pm.timeTotal 'รวมเวลา' (L201) · signatureTitle=pm.signatureLabel 'ลายเซ็นลูกค้า / ผู้ดูแลอาคาร' (L205) — all three byte-identical to the prototype — plus checkProgress=pm.checkProgress '{n}/{count} รายการ', whose shape is exactly the prototype's '5/5 รายการ' (L201), and rowParts='อะไหล่' which already exists in the phrases layer (L201). 6 values are net-new and staged in agents/orch-d-recon/pm-close-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (docs/extract/i18n-full.json is UNTOUCHED by this slice): title 'สรุป + ปิดงาน' (L197) · summaryTitle 'สรุปงาน' (L200) · rowChecks 'ผลตรวจ' (L201) · rowTime 'เริ่ม-เสร็จ' (L201) · repairCount 'ซ่อม {n}' (the parameterised form of the prototype's 'ซ่อม 1', L201 — the pm_checklist 'ตรวจแล้ว {n}/{count}' precedent) · recipient 'ผู้รับบริการ' (L209). Each already resolves in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th — the pm_jobs / st_grlist / notif / approve / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent) and lights up en/zh/ar once applied. B-331 ADDED THREE SLOTS AND MINTED NOTHING: the CTA now performs a real close (the signature encoding was ruled — stroke JSON — which closed B-288), so the bar has to report where that write STANDS. All three reuse EXISTING dict keys already carrying these exact states on pm-checkin / pm-checklist / pm-notes: closed=pm.closedNote 'ปิดงานแล้ว · ลูกค้าลงนามรับงาน' · queued=tax.etax.statusPending 'รอส่ง' · failed=admin.common.actionFailedToast. pm.closedNote is the notable one: it was UNUSABLE before, because 'the customer signed for the work' was exactly the claim nothing backed; a stored customer_sign now makes it literally true, and it is the same column every other surface reads as done. The pad's own two additions are ZERO-MINT BY CONSTRUCTION — the clear control is icon-only (an icon needs no key) and the empty pad shows a draw glyph rather than a prompt, since signatureTitle sits directly above the box and already names what it is. NOT REPRESENTED HERE — three prototype strings are still DROPPED rather than keyed, because each is a CLAIM and a claim cannot be em-dashed the way a missing value can: (1) the success-view heading (L189, 'ปิดงาน PM สำเร็จ') and (2) its subtitle's second line (L190, 'ส่งใบรับรองผล PM ให้ลูกค้าผ่าน LINE แล้ว') state a certificate was pushed to the customer over LINE — lineNotifyStub is a verified no-op (B-108b) and no certificate exists to send, so the whole success view (L185-194) goes with them (the st-receive/B-266 precedent: the confirmation is the state change plus a pop, not a screen announcing effects nobody performs); (3) the CTA label (L213, 'ปิดงาน PM + ส่งรายงาน') carries that same report-send promise, so it stays replaced by pm.closeWithSignBtn — which now names a capability the control really has. The empty pad's prototype hint (L207, 'แตะเพื่อให้ลูกค้าลงนาม' — 'tap to have the customer sign') is still not keyed, but for a new reason: the pad is no longer inert, it is simply drawn on rather than tapped, so the sentence describes the wrong gesture.
_layers: dict (t): rowAsset · rowTotalTime · signatureTitle · close · closed · queued · failed. dict (tf): checkProgress. phrases (tp): title · summaryTitle · rowChecks · rowTime · rowParts · repairCount · recipient.
